problem:
Consider the change of variables given by the matrix equation

$$
[\begin{aligned}{x}_{1} \\ {x}_{2}\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}\frac{3}{5} & \frac{4}{5} \\ \frac{4}{5} & -\frac{3}{5}\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}{y}_{1} \\ {y}_{2}\end{aligned}],
$$

and the curve $C,$ defined as

$$
C:\,11{x}_{1}^{2}-24{x}_{1}{x}_{2}+4{x}_{2}^{2}+12{x}_{1}+16{x}_{2}=20.
$$

Given that the change of variables above reduces $Q(x)=11{x}_{1}^{2}-24{x}_{1}{x}_{2}+4{x}_{2}^{2}$ to its canonical (diagonal) form $20{y}_{2}^{2}-5{y}_{1}^{2}$ what type of a quadratic curve is defined by $C?$
